subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If the host or persistence adapter dies before publication, after the remote write but before receipt persistence/return, or after receipt persistence but before caller acknowledgement, then the system shall recover from durable host-side handoff, idempotency, and receipt state outside every child write surface; resume under UB-21 without re-running implementation, and converge to the same exact-readable artifact and receipt or one named non-accepting failed terminal
intent: one recovered publication attempt, never a duplicate artifact or lost successful write
fit_criterion: kill/restart fixtures at every named boundary plus a concurrent retry produce exactly one artifact and the same receipt/verified EVT-13, or one failed EVT-13 after the policy bound; protected-state mutation and replay attempts fail
